mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity present value, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of observed easing cycles, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the pre-easing period mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates, compressing the present value of equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of observed tightening cycles, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the pre-tightening period mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, prompting central banks to hold rates steady and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of observed strengthening labor periods, or 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the pre-strengthening period mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, prompting central banks to cut rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of observed weakening labor periods, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the pre-weakening period mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105.7 for 3 consecutive months indicates robust manufacturing activity, prompting central banks to hold rates steady and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of observed high-INDPRO periods, or 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the pre-high-INDPRO period mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly home sales (HOUST) above 1036 units for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening housing market, prompting central banks to hold rates steady and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of observed high-HOUST periods, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the pre-high-HOUST period mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly home sales (HOUST) below 1000 units for 3 consecutive months indicates a weakening housing market, prompting central banks to cut rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of observed low-HOUST periods, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the pre-low-HOUST period mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over 3 consecutive months indicates a disinflationary trend, prompting central banks to hold rates steady and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of observed disinflation periods, or 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the pre-disinflation period mean (t-test p > 0.05).
